title: Staff with a Round Engraved End
description: After the attack, the old shaman takes a close interest in the staff Sintel carries.

title: A Wounded Little Dragon
description: Sintel's bond with the little dragon begins: she finds him wounded and nurses him back to health.

title: A Much Larger Dragon
description: A huge dragon takes Scales from Sintel. Finding it becomes her whole quest.

title: A Tree Engraved on a Disc
description: An engraved disc shows a lone tree: the landmark that leads her to the dragon's lair.

title: An Enormous Dragon in the Cave
description: The great dragon is real, and Sintel has finally found where it lives.

title: A Young Dragon Asleep on a Rock
description: A young dragon sleeps in the same cave as the great dragon.

title: The Fallen Dragon Is Scales
description: The dragon Sintel fought is Scales, grown up. Her long search ends with her striking down the friend she set out to save.
